purpose: Define a professional CBD repository landing page using the shared scientific-model suite shell while preserving CBD's event-driven cognitive state-transition paradigm and evidence-level boundaries.

canonical_identity.plain_language_purpose: CBD models how agent-level cognitive states can change over ordered information events through memory, decay, nonlinear transformations and stochastic decisions.
canonical_identity.technical_identity: An event-driven cognitive state-transition and agent-level stochastic dynamical model informed by systems thinking; not currently a formal System Dynamics model.
canonical_identity.paradigm_boundary: Persistent state, temporal ordering and nonlinear/stochastic updates do not by themselves imply closed endogenous System Dynamics feedback.

current_public_state.mod14_boundary: Normative proposition-level Bayesian reference operator; not a calibrated population model, literal Bayesian-brain claim or truth oracle.

first_page_order: What CBD establishes and does not establish

conceptual_figure.layout: persistent agent state -> event-driven updates -> memory/decay/nonlinear/stochastic transformations -> evidence-level interpretation -> validation boundary
prohibited: closed causal-loop notation implying formal System Dynamics
presenting Share as automatically generating future exposure
presenting synthetic recovery as human validation
presenting MOD.14 as a literal brain mechanism or truth oracle

public_readme_boundary.reason: This branch is a design/review preview only. Public README and assets remain unchanged until visual/editorial review.
